integrity_note: The exact analytic theorem, the quadratic-form identity and the standard-library verifier agree. Tests are finite corroboration, not a substitute for all-parameter proof. scientific_limitations: The result concerns a complete unit-edge core with one positive, equal-length private pendant edge at every core vertex, and its shortest-path metric. It does not cover heterogeneous pendants, other base graphs, resistance metrics, or full powered-distance inertia above threshold.
title: A logarithmic collapse law for negative type of weighted complete-graph coronas
